tower.interpretation: A finite sample of the irrational torus orbit. Every full vertical section is countable; the theorem, not the picture, proves orbit nullity. Dual average is exactly R/pi.
tower.point_and_algebra_convention: S_s(x,y)=(x+s/c,y+b*s/c); theta_s f=f composed with S_-s; KT4 uses F_s=S_-s.
